class.name: CubismModel2D
class.brief_description: Resource-based Cubism runtime node with independent animation and rendering state.
class.description: Owns one internal model runtime and its renderer. Assign an imported [CubismModelResource] to [member model]. The internal runtime is not saved as a scene child. Provides lifecycle, processing, queued parameter control, native motion/expression playback, opt-in autoplay, seeded blink, native breath and smoothed look targeting. Use [CubismCharacterController] to coordinate recorded voice and motion cues. Rendering properties select direct or fallback composition and control mask quality. Parameter writes apply once on the next update in the selected [enum ParameterLayer], defaulting to after physics and pose. The batch is captured before evaluation; callback writes wait for the next step. Getters return evaluated values. Unload, reload, and tree exit discard pending writes. Use [method Node.queue_free] for deletion from signal callbacks.

method.name: get_parameter_value
method.description: Return the last evaluated parameter value, or zero for an unavailable parameter. Queued writes do not change this value immediately.

method.name: set_parameter_value
method.description: Queue current*(1-weight)+value*weight at the selected layer. Finite values and weights in [0,1] are required. Unknown parameters, invalid layers and exhausted shared queue capacity return an Error without mutation. Within each layer, operations retain call order. The layer order takes precedence over submission order between layers.

method.name: add_parameter_value
method.description: Queue current+value*weight. Validation, ordering and lifetime follow [method set_parameter_value]. Each blend result is clamped to the model parameter range.

method.name: multiply_parameter_value
method.description: Queue current*(1+(value-1)*weight). Validation, ordering and lifetime follow [method set_parameter_value]. Each blend result is clamped to the model parameter range.

method.name: get_hit_area_names
method.description: Unique hit names in manifest order, or empty without a loaded model. Duplicate names combine their drawables into one logical area.

method.name: hit_test
method.description: Test a node-local pixel point against the named area's current deformed drawable bounds using SDK IsHit. Geometry only: visibility, opacity, triangles and texture alpha do not affect this query. Unknown names, missing or empty drawables, nonfinite points and unloaded models return false. Does not change hover state.

method.name: set_hit_test_target
method.description: Track one pointer target in node-local pixels. The application supplies mouse, touch or controller positions; use to_local(global_point) for world positions. Deferred hit_area_entered/exited signals reflect changes and animation updates. Repeated calls before delivery coalesce to the latest target. Invalid coordinates emit runtime_warning and retain the previous target.

method.name: clear_hit_test_target
method.description: Stop tracking and defer exits for entered areas. Call when the pointer leaves the interaction surface or ends. Reload, unload and tree exit also discard the target. Hidden or process-disabled nodes emit exits; showing or enabling reevaluates a retained target. Model pause freezes geometry but allows target changes.

method.name: set_look_target
method.description: Set a target in node-local pixels. Imported layout is undone, then each half-canvas extent maps to full SDK direction, clamped to [-1,1]. Use to_local(global_point) for a world target. Native SDK smoothing adds standard head/body/eye movement after breath and before physics/pose/manual overrides. Weight must be finite and in [0,1]. Invalid arguments or an unloaded model emit runtime_warning and preserve the previous target.

method.name: clear_look_target
method.description: Discard the transient target and reset smoothing. Influence disappears on the next evaluation. Safe without a loaded model. Reload and tree exit also discard targets.

method.name: set_expression
method.description: Play a separately owned native expression, preserving R5 blending. -1 uses source fades; a nonnegative override sets fade-in and fade-out for this play. Fade time follows model speed and pause, starting on the first evaluation. Successful changes queue expression_changed.

method.name: clear_expression
method.description: Fade expression influence back to the current primary-motion pose, then reset the expression manager. -1 uses the last expression's fade-out; zero removes influence on the next evaluation. Queues expression_changed with an empty ID. Invalid arguments emit runtime_warning.

method.name: get_expression_ids
method.description: Return loaded expression IDs, or an empty list without a ready model.

method.name: play_motion
method.description: Start a native motion with independent playback state. Does not start audio. Check the returned handle's terminal state before awaiting its finished signal. Finite speed must be in (0,256].

method.name: play_motion_from_group
method.description: Resolve a group and ordered index, then play its stable motion ID.

method.name: get_motion_ids
method.description: Return the loaded motion catalog's stable IDs.

method.name: stop_motion
method.description: Terminate the active handle as STOPPED. Zero removes influence immediately. Positive durations fade in model time; -1 uses the native default in motion time. The native pose can keep fading after the handle becomes terminal.

method.name: load_model
method.description: Load a resource and return a Redot error code. A null resource clears the selection. Lifecycle signals are deferred.

method.name: unload_model
method.description: Dispose the runtime, retaining the public selection for an explicit reload.

method.name: reload_model
method.description: Reload the selected resource and discard pending writes.

method.name: advance
method.description: Advance only in manual playback mode while the node can process and is not paused.

method.name: get_canvas_info
method.description: Return native canvas metadata: [code]size_in_pixels[/code] and [code]origin_in_pixels[/code] as Vector2, and [code]pixels_per_unit[/code] as float. Returns an empty dictionary without a ready model.

method.name: get_last_error
method.description: Return the last model-loading error message. Renderer configuration errors are exposed separately through [member rendering_error].

method.name: get_model_state
method.description: Return the current model lifecycle state.

method.name: get_parameter_ids
method.description: Return native parameter IDs in model order, or an empty array without a ready model.

method.name: get_part_ids
method.description: Return native part IDs in model order, or an empty array without a ready model.

method.name: has_parameter
method.description: Whether a ready model contains [param id].

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Whether the model has reached [constant READY].

method.name: set_part_opacity
method.description: Queue a part-opacity override for the next model evaluation, after physics and pose. Finite opacity is clamped to [0,1]. Returns ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER for nonfinite input, ERR_UNCONFIGURED without a ready model, ERR_DOES_NOT_EXIST for an unknown part, or a queue-capacity error. Pending writes are discarded on unload, reload and tree exit.

signal.name: hit_area_entered
signal.description: Deferred transition into a tracked logical area. All overlapping areas are reported in manifest order. Exits precede enters. Use queue_free for deletion from callbacks.

signal.name: hit_area_exited
signal.description: Deferred transition out of a previously entered area, including target clear and model unload. Destruction does not promise further callbacks.

signal.name: expression_changed
signal.description: Deferred notification of a successful expression change. An empty ID means expression influence was requested to clear; a fade may still be running.

signal.name: model_failed
signal.description: Deferred model-loading failure with an error code and diagnostic message.

signal.name: model_load_started
signal.description: Deferred notification that loading the selected resource started.

signal.name: model_ready
signal.description: Deferred notification that the selected resource loaded successfully.

signal.name: motion_event
signal.description: Deferred native motion event. The value is application data and is never executed as code by the plugin.

signal.name: motion_finished
signal.description: Deferred completion notification for a motion handle, with a [enum CubismMotionHandle.FinishReason]. Outgoing native influence may continue fading after completion.

signal.name: motion_looped
signal.description: Deferred loop-boundary notification with the handle and cumulative loop count.

signal.name: motion_started
signal.description: Deferred notification of an accepted motion play.

signal.name: runtime_warning
signal.description: Deferred diagnostic for a rejected runtime operation or unsupported rendering configuration.

members.member: Explicit renderer choice, saved with the node. SubViewport Fallback preserves drawable blend order with an atlas and backdrop compositor. Requires GL Compatibility, SDR, a parent render target larger than 40 pixels on both axes, at most 512 drawable meshes, and an atlas no larger than 4096 pixels per axis or 8388608 total texels. Unsupported configurations draw no character, set rendering_error and emit runtime_warning once per changed error; the requested mode remains selected. Resize or select Direct to recover. Fallback refreshes pixel mapping each rendered frame, including while paused/manual, without advancing animation. Its transient resources are freed on unload or return to Direct. It is not a performance optimization.
Read-only fallback configuration error from the last rendering update. Empty after successful configuration, unload or return to Direct. Not stored in scenes. Does not change model loading state.

Read-only texture encoding of the loaded model; false when unloaded. Configure rendering/premultiplied_alpha during import, then reimport and reload the node. The resource carries the saved choice and matching texture pixels. A mismatched resource is rejected.

Draw a cyan hairline rectangle around combined current drawable geometry, including invisible drawables with triangle indices. Uses evaluated Cubism vertices and imported layout. Does not change simulation. Saved with the node; available in editor, debug and release builds.

Draw magenta hairline rectangles for distinct declared hit drawables, including invisible or non-rendered hit geometry. Missing or empty drawables are skipped. Follows current deformation and imported layout. These are the geometry bounds used by hit_test, not triangle or texture-alpha outlines. Saved with the node.

Policy for mask compositions wholly outside the owning viewport. Visible masks draw every frame; hidden nodes and singular transforms always disable mask drawing. Applied at model evaluation, retained on reload and saved with the node. Does not pause animation, physics, cues or voice. Invalid values emit runtime_warning and retain the previous policy.

Maximum per-composition mask texture dimensions. Defaults to the imported model setting; explicit Low/Medium/High/Custom choices override it and survive reload. Reload the node after reimporting changed model options. Matches viewport pixel density using the largest stretch of the model/camera/canvas/viewport transform, including nonuniform scaling and shear. Geometry scales uniformly, dimensions round outward, and small projected masks are not enlarged to fill the limit. Changes apply on the next model evaluation. Invalid enum values emit runtime_warning and retain the previous quality.
Custom maximum dimension in pixels, clamped to [2,4096]. Used only with MASK_CUSTOM. Both settings are saved with the node. This limits each mask separately, not total model memory.
Apply an attached CubismLipSync component. With no component this has no effect. Disabling releases influence and freezes its envelope. Model pause also freezes the component.
Apply a target only after set_look_target is called. Disabling releases influence and freezes smoothing. The flag is saved, but targets are transient.
Instance-owned blink RNG seed. Setting it resets blink timing, without changing process-global random state or resetting breath.

Apply seeded procedural blink to manifest eye IDs only on frames without primary-motion updates. Suppression and disabling pause its clock. Runs after expression and before physics/pose/manual overrides.
Apply the native SDK breath profile to existing standard parameters. Disabling pauses its clock. Reload resets its phase.

Start configured defaults once after a loaded model enters the tree, and again on reload/reentry. Explicit commands issued before startup take precedence. Changes after startup configure the next load/entry.
Autoplay motion ID. Uses idle priority and the loaded descriptor's loop flag. Empty skips motion playback; audio is not started.
Autoplay expression ID, using its source fades. Empty skips expression playback.
Imported model selection.
Select native idle, physics, or manual playback. Does not replace inherited scene-tree process mode.
Suspend evaluation without consuming queued writes.
Evaluate imported physics after effects and before pose. Has no effect when the model has no physics data.
Evaluate imported pose after physics and before final manual overrides. Has no effect when the model has no pose data.

Scale model time, including motion and effects. Finite values clamp to [0,256]; nonfinite assignments preserve the previous value. Zero freezes model time. A character controller temporarily uses normal speed while it owns the model clock.
